description: A cosy home for your LLMs.

latest_release.name: 0.48.0: Several models at once
latest_release.body:
Models now stay loaded side by side for as long as they fit in memory. When a new one doesn't fit, the app unloads the one you used least recently to make room. This release also updates the engine to b12375, which is built on llama.cpp 1.0.

- Keep several models loaded at once, as many as fit in memory
- Update the engine to b12375, built on llama.cpp 1.0
- Show catalog names in the menu, such as Gemma 4 and GPT-OSS
- Show image and audio input markers on installed models
- Show the audio input marker on recommended models too
- Support video input when ffmpeg is installed with Homebrew
- Keep plus signs in quick prompts, so C++ no longer arrives as C
- Say that agents like Pi and OpenClaw don't need agent mode
